title: Antidepressant Decision Aid for Major Depressive Disorder Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether Antidepressant Decision Aid for Major Depressive Disorder is feasible and effective in involving patients in the decision-making process when initiating pharmacotherapy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with Major Depressive Disorder (MDD)
* No psychotic symptoms
* Based on psychiatrist's clinical judgement currently in need for antidepressant treatment.
* Functional English literacy and language skills (to use the decision aid and fill out the questionnaires)
* Provides consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Psychosis
* Communication barriers (visual impairment, language barrier)
